images.title: Decode a date: 1269
images.purpose: Shows the practice move on one answer: 1269 minus 165 leaves 1104, so month 11 and day 04.
images.composition: A large number on the left, one arrow, and the result split into two coloured digit groups on the right.
images.exact_structure: Left: the number 1269 in large dark numerals. One arrow pointing right, with − 165 above it. Right: the result drawn as two adjacent digit groups with a thin gap, 11 in teal #0072B2 and 04 in amber #E69F00; the leading zero of 04 is drawn clearly, the same size as the 4, and the result is never written as one plain number. Under 11 the word month in teal #0072B2; under 04 the word day in amber #E69F00. Below the row, centred, 4 November in reddish purple #CC79A7. Nothing else is drawn. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, which is large and centred; no scenery, no people, no other text.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec

images.takeaway: The day always takes the last two digits, even when it starts with 0.
images.description: Shows the practice move on one answer: 1269 minus 165 leaves 1104, so month 11 and day 04.
images.context: Practice picture for decoding the date trick answers.
images.teaching_notes: The leading zero is the trap: 04 is the day, not 104.

image_decisions.why: Practice has no tool; one decoded answer with the 04 split shows the move and its trap.
